evidence.title: SEBI (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013 - Code of Conduct
evidence.excerpt: Under SEBI IA Regulations Code of Conduct Clause 1, investment advisers and market intermediaries are strictly prohibited from promising or guaranteeing fixed, assured, or risk-free returns on securities investments.

evidence.title: RBI Sachet Portal - Public Advisory on Fictitious Offers
evidence.excerpt: All market-linked investments carry inherent market risks. Claims of 'zero risk' or 'guaranteed capital multiplication' are recognized indicators of fraudulent unregistered deposit schemes.

evidence.title: SEBI Intermediary Registration Directory
evidence.excerpt: SEBI registers market intermediaries but never 'approves' or endorses individual trading schemes, pre-IPO whatsapp groups, or guaranteed investment packages.

evidence.title: Reserve Bank of India Advisory on Unauthorized Forex & Investment Portals
evidence.excerpt: The Reserve Bank of India does not approve individual private investment programs, guaranteed return clubs, or personal trading account collection pools.
